tools.name: open
tools.description: Opens a pattern, optionally with another measurement file and a size. Returns: The pattern's file, measurement file, unit, object and variable counts, and whether it is modified.

measurements.description: A measurement file to use in place of the one the pattern names

size.description: The size to use from a size table

tools.name: save
tools.description: Saves the pattern. Returns: The pattern's file, measurement file, unit, object and variable counts, and whether it is modified.

path.description: Where to save it, a .sloper file; by default, where it was opened from. A file that is not a pattern is never replaced

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Converts the pattern to another unit, rewriting only lengths, as one undo step. While a number's role is open nothing changes and the reply lists it; mark each and call again. Returns: `converted` true and the new `units`; or `converted` false and the `undecided` numbers, each with its object, `field`, `token`, `number`, `formula` and `position` in it.

marks.description: The numbers the formulas leave open, each marked as a length or a number

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

field.description: The field the number is in

token.description: The number's token, as the reply listed it

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undoes the last change. Returns: The pattern's file, measurement file, unit, object and variable counts, and whether it is modified.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redoes the change last undone. Returns: The pattern's file, measurement file, unit, object and variable counts, and whether it is modified.

tools.name: get_measurements
tools.description: Lists the current measurement set: its file, sizes and values in mm. Returns: `path`, `size` and `sizes` for a size table, and `measurements`, each with `key`, `value` and `description`.

tools.name: set_measurement
tools.description: Adds or changes one value in the measurement file, and saves the file. Returns: `key`, `value`, whether it was `added`, and its `oldValue` when it had one.

key.description: The measurement's key, such as waist

size.description: For a size table, the size to change

description.description: Its description; by default, the one it has

tools.name: missing_measurements
tools.description: Lists what the pattern needs that the measurement set lacks. Returns: `missing`, each with its `key` and the `sizes` with no value.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: Lists the variables and objects with their formulas, values and state. Returns: `variables` and `objects`, each as `get_object` gives it.

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Gives one object or variable: its name, ID, type, formulas (as shown), computed values, state and whether it is locked. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: set_formula
tools.description: Changes one formula of an object or variable. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

field.description: The field, such as length or formula

tools.name: rename
tools.description: Renames an object or variable; formulas that use it follow. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Deletes an object or variable that nothing uses. Returns: The pattern's file, measurement file, unit, object and variable counts, and whether it is modified.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: set_locked
tools.description: Locks or unlocks an object. A locked object cannot be moved, edited or deleted, but its formulas still run, so it follows what it uses; a change that would alter it is refused. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

locked.description: true to lock, false to unlock

tools.name: add_variable
tools.description: Adds a variable. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

name.description: Its name, used in formulas as #name

tools.name: add_point
tools.description: Adds a point of any type. The type's members, as on the operations page; points and edges are given by ID or name. Members of each type: freePoint: x, y; offsetPoint: base, mode (polar | cartesian), length, angle, dx, dy; alongEdgePoint: edge, from (start | end), mode (length | ratio), value; betweenPoint: a, b, mode (length | ratio), value; intersectPoint: edgeA, edgeB, extendA, extendB, pick; circleEdgePoint: centre, radius, edge, extend, pick; circleCirclePoint: centreA, radiusA, centreB, radiusB, pick; projectPoint: point, edge, direction (perpendicular | angle), angle, extend. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

name.description: Its name; by default the next free one

tools.name: add_edge
tools.description: Adds an edge: a line, curve, curve path, circle, arc or offset edge. The type's members, as on the operations page; points and edges are given by ID or name. An offset edge's `side` may also be `inside` or `outside` a `piece`. Members of each type: line: start, end; curve: start, end, angle1, length1, angle2, length2; curvePath: nodes (a list, each with point, angle, lengthIn, lengthOut); circle: centre, radius; arc: centre, radius, angle1, angle2; offsetEdge: edge, edges (a list, each with edge, reversed), side (left | right), distance. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

name.description: Its name; by default the next free one

tools.name: add_repeat
tools.description: Adds a repeat: points evenly spaced between two points or along an edge. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

edge.description: Along this edge, in place of a and b

ends.description: Whether the ends have points of their own

name.description: Its name; by default the next free one

tools.name: split_edge
tools.description: Splits an edge at a point on it into two parts; pieces and seams that used it take the parts. Returns: The two parts.

tools.name: add_rectangle
tools.description: Adds a rectangle of four lines from a corner. Returns: The four lines.

width.description: How far right the opposite corner is

height.description: How far down the opposite corner is

tools.name: round_corner
tools.description: Rounds the corner where two edges meet with an arc. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

tools.name: convert_edge
tools.description: Changes an edge to a line or a curve in place, keeping its ID. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: merge_points
tools.description: Merges two or more points into one, which every edge and formula then uses. Returns: The point kept.

tools.name: break_point
tools.description: Breaks a point into one for each edge that meets there. Returns: `points`, the points it became.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: copy_objects
tools.description: Copies points and edges, with what they depend on, as Edit → Copy does. Returns: `fragment`, the copy as text for `paste_objects`; `names`, the copied objects' names; `leftOut`, the names of those that cannot be copied.

objects.description: The points and edges to copy

tools.name: paste_objects
tools.description: Pastes a copy as Edit → Paste does: into the pattern it came from, the objects join what they used there; into another, what they depend on comes too. They take new IDs, and a name already taken the next number. Returns: `objects`, the pasted copies of the copied objects; `renamed`, names that changed, as "A → A2".

tools.name: arrange
tools.description: Aligns or distributes points. Points a formula places are left as they are and listed, unless named in replace. Returns: The names of the points `changed`, `asked` (left, as a formula places them) and `kept`.

reference.description: For aligning: the point to line up with

replace.description: Points placed by a formula to change all the same

tools.name: add_transform
tools.description: Adds rotated, mirrored or moved copies of points and edges. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

sources.description: The points and edges to copy

name.description: The transform's name

suffix.description: Added to the names of the copies

pivot.description: rotate: the point to turn about; move: a point to turn the copies about

angle.description: rotate: how far to turn; mirror with axis.a only: the axis's direction; move: the direction

axis.description: mirror: the line to reflect in

a.description: Or a point on the line

b.description: And a second point on it

length.description: move: how far, at the angle

dx.description: move: how far right, in place of length

rotate.description: move with pivot: how far the copies turn

tools.name: set_role
tools.description: Changes an edge's role. A marking role puts it on the pieces it lies in. Returns: The edge, as `get_object` gives it, with the `pieces` it is marked on.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: set_marker
tools.description: Gives a point or repeat a marker; it is marked on the pieces it lies in. Returns: The edge, as `get_object` gives it, with the `pieces` it is marked on.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

size.description: Its size; by default a size for the marker and the pattern's unit

tools.name: create_piece
tools.description: Makes a piece from the closed outline around a place. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

x.description: Across, in mm, inside the outline

name.description: Its name

allowance.description: Its seam allowance; by default the first material's, or a round value for the pattern's unit

tools.name: set_edge_allowance
tools.description: Gives one edge of a piece its own seam allowance, or clears it. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

allowance.description: The allowance; left out, the edge goes back to the piece's

tools.name: set_grainline
tools.description: Sets a piece's grainline: at an angle, between two points, or none. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: add_notch
tools.description: Adds a notch on a piece's seam line, at a point or a distance along an edge. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

edge.description: Or on this edge of the piece

position.description: With edge: the distance from its start

tools.name: remove_notch
tools.description: Removes a notch. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: add_marking
tools.description: Marks a point or a line on a piece, or adds stitch holes along an edge. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: remove_marking
tools.description: Removes a marking. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: set_cut
tools.description: Sets how many of a piece to cut, and whether every other one is mirrored. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

mirrored.description: Whether every other one is mirrored

tools.name: set_fold
tools.description: Puts a piece on the fold of one of its straight edges, or takes it off. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: set_piece_material
tools.description: Sets the material a piece is cut from. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: set_piece_fill
tools.description: Sets how a piece is filled on screen. Returns: The piece, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The piece, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

color.description: Its own colour, as #rrggbb, or empty for its material's

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: Lists the materials and the cut list. Returns: `materials`, each with `id`, `name`, `color`, `fill`, and `allowance`, `width`, `length` and `allowTurns` when set, and the `cutList`.

tools.name: add_material
tools.description: Adds a material. Returns: The materials and the cut list, as `list_materials` gives them.

name.description: Its name; by default the next free one

fill.description: How pieces of it are filled

tools.name: rename_material
tools.description: Renames a material. Returns: The materials and the cut list, as `list_materials` gives them.

material.description: The material, by ID or name

name.description: The new name

tools.name: set_material
tools.description: Changes a material's colour, fill, seam allowance or size. Pieces that cannot fit its size are problems. Returns: The materials and the cut list, as `list_materials` gives them.

material.description: The material, by ID or name

fill.description: How pieces of it are filled

allowance.description: A seam allowance for pieces of it, in the pattern's unit

width.description: Its width in the pattern's unit, 0 for none, which takes the length away too; a width alone is a roll

length.description: The length of a sheet of it in the pattern's unit, with a width; 0 for a roll

allowTurns.description: Whether pieces may lie a quarter turn round on it, for material with no grain

tools.name: delete_material
tools.description: Deletes a material; its pieces are left with none. Returns: The materials and the cut list, as `list_materials` gives them.

material.description: The material, by ID or name

tools.name: add_seam
tools.description: Adds a seam: two runs of piece edges sewn together, whose lengths are checked. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

sideA.description: Side A, in order along the seam

name.description: Its name

ease.description: How much longer side B should be; by default 0

tolerance.description: How far the difference may be from the ease; by default a small value for the pattern's unit

tools.name: flip_seam
tools.description: Turns a seam's side B round, for edges sewn running the same way. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

tools.name: suggest_seams
tools.description: Suggests pairs of piece edges that look like they are sewn together, without adding them. Returns: `suggestions`, each with `sideA`, `sideB`, whether the edge is `shared`, and the length `difference`.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Adds a note, free or hung from a point, edge or piece; with a leader it is a callout. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

text.description: The text, with draft values such as {=@waist / 4}

anchor.description: What it hangs from; left out for a free note

position.description: With edge: how far along it, 0 to 1

x.description: A free note: its place across

y.description: A free note: its place down

dx.description: A hung note: how far right of what it hangs from

dy.description: A hung note: how far down

print.description: Whether it prints; by default true

leader.description: A line to what it hangs from

font.description: The font family it prints in; empty for the default sans-serif. One not installed prints in the default font

name.description: Its name

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Changes a note's text, size, printing, leader, alignment, box or font. Returns: The object, as `get_object` gives it.

id.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

name.description: The object, by its ID or its name: give "id" or "name".

text.description: The text, with draft values such as {=@waist / 4}

print.description: Whether it prints; by default true

leader.description: A line to what it hangs from

font.description: The font family it prints in; empty for the default sans-serif. One not installed prints in the default font

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Works the pattern out again and lists its problems. Returns: The problems: objects that are invalid or blocked, gaps, and seams out of tolerance.

tools.name: check
tools.description: As evaluate, with the full report of every computed value. Returns: The problems, and every object's computed values.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Draws the pattern as SVG or as a PNG image, as the drafting window shows it. Returns: `format` and the `svg` text; or, for png, the `png` file as base64 and its `width`.

format.description: svg, or png for an image; by default svg

width.description: png: the image's width in pixels, from 16 to 4096; by default 1600. Its height follows the drawing

hiddenRoles.description: Roles of edges to leave out

annotations.description: Whether to draw notes; by default true

garment.description: The Garment view instead: each piece as sewn, darts closed and folds opened, shaded, arranged as on the canvas; labels, hiddenRoles, annotations and region do not apply. By default false

material.description: garment: only the pieces cut from this material, by name; by default all

tools.name: ui_state
tools.description: Gives the design window's state: its pattern file, the selection, the label mode and the part of the draft in view. Only through opensloper-cli serve --connect, with the window in automation mode. Returns: `file`, `modified`, `units`, `selection` (each with `id`, `name` and `type`), `labels` and `view`, the region in view in mm (`minX`, `minY`, `maxX`, `maxY`), which `render` takes as its `region`.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Exports a saved layout file as PDF, SVG, DXF or machine DXF. Returns: The `path` written.

path.description: The file to write, ending in the format's extension (.pdf, .svg or .dxf)

format.description: By default, from the file name's extension

profile.description: A machine profile from the settings, in place of the layout's
